input_needed.description: Specific non-secret input or permission needed from the operator; empty when none. Never include credentials, secret values, environment dumps or raw logs.

failure_reason.description: Specific observed reason for failure or expiration; empty when unknown or not failed. Never include credentials, secret values, environment dumps or raw logs.

change_summary.description: Short factual summary of actual code changes; empty if not established. Never include credentials, secret values, environment dumps or raw logs.

validation_summary.description: Actual commands and observed validation results, including failures; never invent passing checks. Never include credentials, secret values, environment dumps or raw logs.
